{{Top|leg}}
'''Braco''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Braco related a story on the entry for the [[WED15-D3]] about how a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], possibly [[Moruth Doole]], tried to use the droids to process [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]]. The droids ended up shredding and tearing the glitterstim, causing the loss of millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Braco's uncle, a member of [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]], was highly amused when he heard the story.<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
